notes.title: Bryce Tiles 1.0.16 Patch
notes.content:
Sorry it's been a while since the last update, I've been trying to get the word out on the streets about Bryce Tiles' existence! If you've bought the game and not left a review yet, please throw a couple of words down, I'd really appreciate it! Until then, keep having fun playing the campaigns, discovering the secrets of Bryce Tiles and making your own levels!

Hopefully the level editor will be ready for full release soon, JJJJ has currently got it in full [strike]dogfooding[/strike] testing mode and is working on a Workshop Exclusive™ campaign... stay tuned for more on that! If you want to test the level editor and workshop integration, simply run the game with -leveleditor launch option.

Bug reports! Please send any here:
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd2XEtp4xkFLBgQ1aRlJWqQ70xI4TaJG08DqRLl752asEv17g/viewform]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd2XEtp4xkFLBgQ1aRlJWqQ70xI4TaJG08DqRLl752asEv17g/viewform[/url]

notes.title: Bryce Tiles 1.0.14 Patch
notes.content:
A few little fixes! If you're an escape key spammer, please test it out in weird places now and see if it breaks! The awful hack I put in for SteamDeck should only work on SteamOS now, but I'll try and make it less hacky in future (newer Godot has a fix for the SteamDeck double input bug, but I'm still on an ancient version that requires crude workarounds).

Send me more bugs, please:

[list]
[*] laser emitters now recalc on door open/close

[/list]

notes.content:
More level editor fixes, I really hope this fixes the offset items bug and some more of the crashes. Please keep testing and accept my apologies for all of these bugs, the level editor is still very beta and needs a lot of playing around with... so thanks everyone so far!

[h3]Awesome Fixes 1.0.12 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] (level editor) "back to editor" option text position during test level hackily fixed
[*] (level editor) fixed a problem with Immovable2 loading incorrectly
[*] (level editor) added emergency hold quit key during test mode (in case you get stuck in an enemy loop)
[*] (level editor) stopped filename box scrollbars from showing on long filenames
[*] (level editor) fixed big offset bug with testing/saving exporting levels
[*] (level editor) added possible error if can't save btlev file (it might work)
[*] added theme song vocalist full name (to dissuade any possible suggestions of garbage-trash A.I. generation)
[*] "Theme Song Written/Produced by Elvisish" credit elaborated on to clarify no A.I. used in Bryce Tiles whatsoever
[/list]
Level editor handbook: [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_Kh8_DmHuTgYiDSfg3zCGHRu37DL5H7Q/]https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_Kh8_DmHuTgYiDSfg3zCGHRu37DL5H7Q/[/url]

I managed to track down the singer of the theme tune and she was happy for me to share her info: her name is Marnée Richardson and you can find her (or hire her yourself!) from [url=http://marneerichardson.com]http://marneerichardson.com[/url].

The song was written and recorded back in June 2021 (less than a month after production on the game started, crazily enough) but I didn't see any reason to even release the song until the Steam page was made in January 2023 (if I'd known what I know now, I'd have released it back in 2021, of course).

Since there was some suggestion that the song/singer was A.I, this confirms ABSOLUTELY NOT and no part of Bryce Tiles or its music or art or sound was A.I. generated in any way whatsoever, nor will any game by Brilliance or subsidiaries. The theme song was written and produced by Elvisish and all of the level music was composed by JJJJ, with some secret stage additional music (and altered themes) by Elvisish.

notes.title: Bryce Tiles 1.0.8 Patch
notes.content:
Another patch, phew, these are getting frequent! The doubler exit bug should be fixed finally, but if it's still possible to break, please file a report: [url=https://forms.gle/9YmGkL8X7vV32CJPA]https://forms.gle/9YmGkL8X7vV32CJPA[/url]

Blocked doors would spam an open sound on each move, that should be fixed now (leave a block or enemy on an open door and unpress the pushpad, if it keeps making a sound, I haven't fixed it)

I made a tiny fix to the level editor so the exporter (which broke right before release) now should work, but it's still very much in beta mode, so if you'd like to test the level editor, just add the line -leveleditor to the launch options in Steam (or add to a shortcut):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43547255/513643ff21f0cac962515df710704fb1b78882c1.jpg[/img]

Here's the Level Editor Handbook I threw together in the early hours of the morning (around 4) so if it's a bit rough, my apologies: [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_Kh8_DmHuTgYiDSfg3zCGHRu37DL5H7Q/view?usp=sharing]https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_Kh8_DmHuTgYiDSfg3zCGHRu37DL5H7Q/view?usp=sharing[/url]

Please test the level editor/exporter out and test out the Workshop uploader! I'll enable Workshop visibility on the store page (so you can download other people's campaigns) once there's no confirmed breaking bugs or other embarrassing issues. For now, you can make levels, export campaigns, upload and download from your subscriptions and your own uploads and play campaign files directly from your disk. You can also send .btpak files to friends to play.

[h3]Changelog 1.0.8[/h3]
[list]
[*] doubler game scale now works (only for positive scalings due to keeping both players on screen)
[*] (quite possibly) fixed doubler exit button mash bug
[*] (very probably) fixed blocked door sound spamming
[*] fixed level editor export crash, test the beta mode with -leveleditor launch option
[/list]
Once again, thank you so much for playing Bryce Tiles and hope you have fun discovering all the secrets that lurk beneath its surface!

Double Rumble should actually work now and not crash on exits, and some other weird things I managed to fix by hacking together solutions that least breaks the 4 years of duct-taped game.

Made it to 10 reviews! 30 is the next stop I think? If you haven't reviewed yet, please leave one as I'm trying to prove to myself and the world of indie game devs that:
[olist]

notes.title: Bryce Tiles 1.0.6 Patch
notes.content:
Sorry it's been a while since the last patch, I wanted to get everything working and tested before I submitted it. After some feedback I wanted to fix some issues, add some more secrets and achievements in and tidy up some of the old issues. The settings page is now back to how it was before, the GUI scale has the immediate visual feedback when you change the slider again but I cleaned up the placement a little so it's not as tough to navigate as it was (still tough though). Main menu scaling actually works now I've had a little time to work on it (I didn't just before launch). Trophies now store and show in the level select, which is nice if you're trying to get a personal completionist run. If you have a Mac, please give the Mac build a test, I'm working on getting myself set-up with something so I can test myself, but for now there is at least a build available.

Next up I'll try and get the level editor and workshop support working, I had to remove all of it for release as I just didn't have time to get it working, but hopefully now I can dedicate a little more time to that. If you've bought Bryce Tiles and enjoyed it, I'd really appreciate a review to help try and get the word out! More updates coming soon and thanks again for playing, after 4 years it's really nice to see everyone enjoying playing!
